_comment: File-guard allowlist. Only consulted for files matching WATCHLIST patterns in installer/file_guard.rs. Rules allow specified drifting_mod + file_pattern combinations to modify files silently without triggering restore. Patterns use simple wildcards (* matches any characters); matching is case-insensitive, anchored. Add user rules to data_dir/guard_allowlist_user.json.
